title: What a ZPA Public Service Edge is
aliases: zscaler public service edge for private access

prose.text: A Public Service Edge is the Zscaler-operated broker tier of Private Access, and it is not the ZIA product of the same name.

prose.label: Function.
prose.text: A Public Service Edge brokers like a Private Service Edge: [[zpa.private-service-edges.what-it-is:broker-function]]. It does not inspect traffic: [[zpa.private-service-edges.what-it-is:no-inspection]]. Authentication of the edges and clients: [[zpa.private-service-edges.data-path:pki-roles]]. Active-active deployment: [[zpa.private-service-edges.deployment:active-active]].

prose.label: What is not captured.
prose.text: The failure behavior and Safe-mode are open {{gap:safe-mode}}, and so are caching and reconnect {{gap:ca-reconnect-semantics}}, client selection {{gap:public-selection}}, and a dedicated Public-tier article {{gap:no-public-help-page}}.

checks.do: Whether the question is about Private Access rather than Internet & SaaS, since the ZIA Public Service Edge and the ZIA Virtual Service Edge are other products.
Whether the question assumes an operator can deploy, configure or update a Public Service Edge; Zscaler maintains them.
Whether a scale or fail-safe behavior is asked about: the capture states the scale only, and fail-open or fail-closed behavior is not captured.

public-definition.statement: Public Service Edges for Private Access are deployed in Zscaler data centers around the world; Zscaler maintains them and they are the cloud-based portion of the Private Access data forwarding path.

quotes: are deployed in Zscaler data centers around the world
Maintained by Zscaler and deployed globally, Public Service Edges are the cloud-based portion of the Private Access data forwarding path

operator-role.statement: Zscaler maintains Public Service Edges; the organization manages Private Service Edges.

quotes: Private Service Edges act in the same capacity, but they are managed by an organization.
Zscaler monitors and maintains its Service Edges to ensure continuous availability.

operator-role.conditions: Statement changed from "the organization does not deploy, configure or update a Public Service Edge": nothing says the organization cannot do so. The two quoted sources state who maintains each tier.

scale.statement: Public Service Edges for Private Access can handle hundreds of thousands of concurrent users with millions of concurrent sessions, and enforce access and reauthentication policies.

quotes: Public Service Edges for Private Access (ZPA), addressed here, are deployed in Zscaler data centers around the world and can handle hundreds of thousands of concurrent users with millions of concurrent sessions.
Public Service Edges enforce access and reauthentication policies based on your organization

control-service-edge.statement: For any Microtunnel, the Control Service Edge is the Public Service Edge that handles cloud-level system messages to establish the M-Tunnel.

quotes: For any given Microtunnel (M-Tunnel), the Control Service Edge is the Public Service Edge that handles cloud-level system messages to establish the M-Tunnel.

log-routing.statement: Log data for Public Service Edges is exported to log routers, which direct it to the Log Streaming Service hosted in the geographic region for each organization; the Log Streaming Service analyzes events reported primarily by Public or Private Service Edges.

quotes: For Public Service Edges for Private Access, log routers direct the information to the Log Streaming Service (LSS) hosted in the appropriate geographical region for each organization.
Log data generated for every transaction is compressed, tokenized, and exported over secure TLS connections to log routers.
by analyzing events reported, primarily by the Public Service Edges or Private Service Edges.

no-vse-in-zpa.statement: Virtual Service Edge is an Internet & SaaS (ZIA) product; it does not appear in the ZPA parts of the Python SDK, the Go SDK or the Terraform provider, and ZPA's customer-deployed edge is the Private Service Edge.

quotes: Watch a video about Virtual Service Edges for Internet & SaaS (ZIA)
Private Service Edges for Private Access (ZPA) are single-tenant instance brokers

no-vse-in-zpa.conditions: Absence: git grep -i "virtual service edge" at the pin of vendor/zscaler-sdk-python (zscaler/zpa), vendor/zscaler-sdk-go (zscaler/zpa) and vendor/terraform-provider-zpa returns nothing; the help capture for the Virtual Service Edge is an Internet & SaaS article.

safe-mode.title: Scale, Safe-mode and default URL-block behavior of the ZPA broker tier
safe-mode.detail: The scale statement is now supported by the ZPA page. Unverified legacy statement: per-second CA heartbeat, Safe-mode and default URL-block policy "came from the ZIA page ... Whether any of those behaviors apply to the ZPA broker tier is unconfirmed." No ZPA page states them. Resolve with a ZPA-specific Public Service Edge article.
safe-mode.blocks: describing failure behavior of the Public tier

ca-reconnect-semantics.title: Policy caching and Central Authority reconnect behavior of the Public tier
ca-reconnect-semantics.detail: The Private Service Edge page says a Service Edge registers with the Private Access Cloud, downloads policy and caches path selection ({{broker-function}} in the Private subject), but no page gives cache invalidation, heartbeat cadence or fail-open or fail-closed behavior for the Public tier. Resolve with a ZPA-specific article.
ca-reconnect-semantics.blocks: stating Public tier behavior when the control plane is unreachable

public-selection.title: How a client is assigned a Public Service Edge
public-selection.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Selection: Automatic, by proximity / CA routing" for the Public tier. The captures give App Connectors the nearest Public or Private Service Edge but do not describe client-to-Public-Service-Edge selection. See [[zpa.private-service-edges.client-selection]] for the Private-side levers. Resolve with the Private Access architecture documentation.
public-selection.blocks: explaining why a client landed on a given Public Service Edge

no-public-help-page.title: Dedicated ZPA Public Service Edge help page
no-public-help-page.detail: The pages help.zscaler.com/zpa/about-public-service-edges is not served by the capture tool; the Public tier description rests on the understanding-service-edges and architecture pages. Resolve if that article is published.
